title: Xylem Inoculation with flg22
author: Cleo Bagchus
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.752hq8e

steps.title: Apply first flg22 droplet
steps.instruction: Place 15 µL of flg22 3 cm above the lesion on the central vein of the leaf.

steps.title: Inoculate first droplet into xylem
steps.instruction: Puncture through the droplet into the central vein three times using the needle, ensuring the leaf is not punctured completely to allow the droplet to be sucked into the xylem via pressure difference.

steps.title: Apply second flg22 droplet
steps.instruction: Place a second 15 µL of flg22 3.5 cm above the lesion on the central vein of the leaf.

steps.title: Inoculate second droplet into xylem
steps.instruction: Repeat the puncture process for the second droplet as described in the previous inoculation step.
